criteria.criterion: Regular fixed and country players share exclusive playback ownership within the tested browser profile/device.
criteria.evidence: tools-list.json reports open_radio -> ui://dial/radio-v6.html and find_stations_by_country -> ui://dial/country-v4.html. Both Inspector resources/read responses are text/html;profile=mcp-app and contain the playback-coordinator bundle. The radio app CSP has connectDomains []; resourceDomains [https://stream.radioparadise.com]. The country app CSP has connectDomains []; resourceDomains [https://stream.radioparadise.com, https://audio.bfmtv.com, https://media-ssl.musicradio.com]. These checks confirm packaging only; actual regular-player two-thread ownership in ChatGPT has not been observed.
criteria.method: Use MCP Inspector against the refreshed local endpoint to inspect tool metadata, read both delivered UI resources, and confirm coordinator packaging. Require actual ChatGPT regular-player use in two threads for the browser/profile ownership claim.

criteria.criterion: Play in a second thread pauses the previous player before starting; simultaneous and canceled attempts cannot overlap or restart stale audio.
criteria.evidence: The Implement report records 27 passing automated tests plus passing targeted regressions for late play fulfillment, current media pause ownership release, and queued old Pause during a new lock wait. No actual ChatGPT regular-player two-thread takeover or audible test was performed in this Verify run, so host overlap and stale-audio behavior remain unverified.
criteria.method: Review the accepted candidate's automated test evidence and require actual two-thread regular-player takeover in both directions, including simultaneous/canceled attempts and audible outcome.

criteria.criterion: Either thread can request Pause of the active player and show acknowledged versus unconfirmed status honestly.
criteria.evidence: The radio-v6 and country-v4 UI resources were delivered successfully, but no actual ChatGPT two-thread remote Pause interaction or status observation was performed. The Inspector calls do not establish owner acknowledgment behavior.
criteria.method: Inspect regular-player delivered resource packaging and require actual remote Pause requests from each thread with observed acknowledged/unconfirmed UI status.

criteria.criterion: Missing APIs, unresponsive owners, rapid actions and close/remount recovery have bounded safe behavior.
criteria.evidence: Implement reports the queued-pause and stale-play regressions passing in the local suite. This Verify run did not exercise an actual ChatGPT host with missing APIs, an unresponsive owner, or a closed/remounted player. Candidate notes explicitly leave actual background and close/remount behavior unobserved.
criteria.method: Use recorded automated regression results for rapid/canceled actions and require actual host checks for unavailable APIs, unresponsive owner, and close/remount recovery.

criteria.criterion: Meaningful automated and delivered-resource tests pass, followed by independent Review and actual two-thread host playback/recovery verification.
criteria.evidence: The accepted Implement report records npm test with 27 passed and 0 failed; independent Review accepted attempt 3. Inspector tools/list, open_radio app metadata, find_stations_by_country app metadata, both regular-player resources/read responses, open_radio call, and a bounded FR station lookup all succeeded. The open_radio call returned Radio Paradise (MP3 128 kbps); the country call returned three supported FR stations. No actual ChatGPT two-thread regular-player playback, remote Pause, or close/remount recovery evidence was supplied, so the full conjunctive criterion remains blocked. The saved Inspector evidence is in factory/work-items/DIAL-004/evidence/verify1/; FR click tokens are redacted there.
criteria.method: Check accepted-candidate test and Review records, independently use Inspector tools/list, tools/call, app metadata and resources/read, and check for actual two-thread host playback/recovery evidence.

blocked: Regular fixed-player takeover in two ChatGPT threads, both directions, with audible checks.
Regular country-player takeover in two ChatGPT threads, both directions, with audible checks.
Remote Pause from either thread and observed acknowledged versus unconfirmed status.
Actual host checks for missing APIs, unresponsive owner, and rapid interactions.
Close/remount recovery and peer ownership recovery.
host_checklist.scope_note: Inspector and local automated checks do not substitute for actual host playback/recovery evidence. No full feature PASS is claimed.
